run_agent_result.question: How much free cash flow did Microsoft generate in FY2025?
run_agent_result.final_answer:
**Microsoft FY2025 (fiscal year ended June 30, 2025) free cash flow: $71.611 billion.**

Components, both directly-filed figures (not derived), sourced from the annual cash flow statement as filed 2026-07-29:

| Item | FY2025 |
|---|---|
| Operating cash flow (`NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities`) | $136.162B |
| Capex (`PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment`) | $64.551B |
| **Free cash flow** | **$71.611B** |

For context, the same series shows FY2024 FCF of $74.071B and FY2023 of $59.475B — so FY2025 FCF came down slightly year over year even though operating cash flow grew, because capex rose faster. (FY2026, ended June 30, 2026, shows $66.987B on $182.935B operating cash flow and $115.948B capex.)
